newsitem.title: UK: Rank to seek authority for share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Rank to seek authority for share repurchase.

text.p: Rank Group Plc said on Thursday that it would propose a resolution at its annual meeting in April authorising the company to purchase up to 10 percent of its ordinary shares.
Shareholders will be asked to amend the company's articles to that effect at the April 10 meeting but a company spokesman said this did not mean the company was planning a buy-back.
Rank Group also plans to expand its Hard Rock chain, opening cafes at the rate of one a month for three years from July 1997.

The spokesman said the split would be roughly 50-50 between owned and franchised properties. Rank last year boosted its Hard Rock portfolio from 38 to 76 cafes after buying those owned by joint founder Peter Morton and the Canadian operation.
